description: Plan a lipid nanoparticle (LNP) formulation for RNA: from RNA mass, N/P ratio and lipid mol% (e.g. ionizable lipid/DSPC/cholesterol/PEG-lipid 50/10/38.5/1.5), calculate moles, mass and stock volume of every lipid, the ethanol and aqueous phase volumes at the chosen mixing ratio (default 3:1), and final RNA concentration, ethanol fraction and lipid:RNA ratio. Molecular weights must come from the user or certificates of analysis.

inputSchema.description: Input contract for the Verbex lipid nanoparticle (LNP) formulation calculator: lipid amounts from RNA mass, N/P ratio and lipid mol%, and the ethanol and aqueous phase volumes for mixing.

aqueousToEthanolRatio.description: Volume ratio of aqueous (RNA) phase to ethanol (lipid) phase at mixing; 3 means 3:1.

aqueousVolume.description: Volume of the aqueous RNA phase.

lipids.description: Every lipid in the formulation; mol% must add up to 100 and exactly one is the ionizable lipid.

aminesPerMolecule.description: Ionizable amines per molecule of the ionizable lipid.

ionizable.description: True for the ionizable (cationic) lipid that sets the N/P ratio.

molecularWeight.description: g/mol, from the certificate of analysis (PEG-lipids are averages).

stockConcentration.description: Concentration of the lipid stock in ethanol.

npRatio.description: Molar ratio of ionizable-lipid amines (N) to RNA phosphates (P).

nucleotideMolecularWeight.description: Average mass per nucleotide used to estimate RNA phosphate (g/mol).

rnaMass.description: Mass of RNA (mRNA, siRNA, sgRNA) to encapsulate.

name: lnp_formulation

card.description: What the Verbex card draws; same values as the notebook entry.

notebookEntry.description: Markdown entry to paste into a lab notebook.

title: LNP formulation (lipid nanoparticles)
